verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll and business-banking platform, so approval permissions for payments are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers business formation, bank accounts, a Money Dashboard, developer APIs, an MCP server, a CLI and webhooks, but nothing on approval permissions, designated approvers, or one-click payment approval and sending.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set up approval permissions so designated teammates can approve and send payments with one click
